description_en: Enables or disables the free use of groups by calling EnableAutoGroupCreation
description_zh: 本文介绍如何调用EnableAutoGroupCreation开启和关闭自由使用Group
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka enable-auto-group-creation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-mp919o4v0000 --enable true --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableAutoGroupCreation

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437663.html to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the free use of groups. Valid values:

- **true**: Enable.
- **false**: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
启用或禁用自由使用 Group。取值范围如下：

- **true**：启用。
- **false**：禁用
parameters.name: enable
